card.name: Inside capitalized drug and heading names
card.fires_on: Early pieces of long drug names or section headings written in capitals, such as PROMETHAZINE, ZOLADEX, JARDIANCE or DEMENTIA. It fires where the rest of the word is still to come.

modes.label: All-caps generic names
modes.description: The first or middle piece of a generic drug name written in capitals.
modes.example: THE LOWEST EFFECTIVE DOSE OF<< PROM>>ETHAZINE HYDROCHL

modes.label: Brand names
modes.description: Partway through a brand name, often as it is repeated in the label.
modes.example: fatal ketoacidosis has occurred with JARDIANCE. JARD<<I>>ANCE is not indicated for glycemic control

modes.label: Capitalized warning headings
modes.description: The first piece of a capitalized medical term in a heading.
modes.example: INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY PATIENTS WITH<< D>>EMENTIA-RELATED PSYCHOS

card.writes: It pushes the model toward word pieces starting with letters like PU, SU, AU, MU and CU, and away from RE-type and DEST pieces.
card.plain: It marks the start of a long capitalized drug or heading word that is still being spelled out.
